q-0389.answer:
Surah Al-Muminoon (23) — The Believers · 118 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• They will not be successful with Him on the Day of Resurrection; they will not prosper or be saved.
• Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
• They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
• And they who turn away from ill speech
• And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0442.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0653.answer:
Surah Al-Fajr (89) — The Dawn · 30 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Lord is Ever Watchful
• They do not command that the poor and the needy be treated with kindness, nor do they encourage each other to do so.
• To His company, His reward and what He has prepared for His servants in His Paradise.
• He sent down a torment upon them from the sky and caused them to be overcome by a punishment that could not be repelled from the people who were criminals.
• In abundance. This increases some of them in their wickedness.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Surah Al-Kahf (18) — The Cave · 110 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To those who oppose His Prophet ﷺ and disbelieve in His Book, He issues a warning of severe punishment hastened in this world and postponed to the world Hereafter.
• Their overwhelming punishment, destroying every last one of them.
• This thing that I did deliberately is one of the things I told you not to denounce me for, because you do not know the full story, and there is a reason and purpose for it that you do not know about.
• It has no basis apart from what they say, and they have no evidence for it apart from their own lies and fabrications.
